Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. Whether you're tracking sprint progress, managing a content calendar, or organizing client work, you can now save your favorite filters, sorts, and grouping settings as a custom view you can return to anytime, instead of rebuilding them from scratch every time you open a project.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to set up dedicated views for different projects, clients, or workflows. Once you've built a view you like, you can share it with your team so everyone works from the same setup and stays aligned on priorities. Shared views make onboarding new teammates easier too, since they can jump straight into a familiar, organized workspace.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so every team can start organizing work in a way that fits how they actually operate.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
